description: This line plot illustrates the relative change across different layer groups for various token and precision configurations compared to a baseline. The x-axis is categorical, displaying five sequential layer groups: "Layer1-4", "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32". The y-axis represents "Relative Change" on a linear scale, ranging from -15% to 5% with tick marks at regular 5% intervals. The plot contains five lines. A grey dashed line without markers represents the "Baseline of 4x tokens, 4-bit" and remains constant at exactly 0% across all layer groups. A solid yellow line with circular markers, corresponding to a blurred legend entry, starts near 0% at Layer1-4, dips slightly to approximately -1% at Layer5-12, returns to 0% at Layer13-20, dips to roughly -0.5% at Layer21-28, and ends at approximately 0.5% at Layer29-32. A solid red line with square markers, labeled "LB-Avg of 1x tokens, 16-bit", begins near 0% at Layer1-4, decreases to about -2.5% at Layer5-12, remains relatively steady near -2% through Layer13-20 and Layer21-28, and rises to end near 0% at Layer29-32. A solid light blue line with circular markers, labeled "RULER4k of 2x tokens, 8-bit", starts near 0% at Layer1-4, declines to approximately -2.5% at Layer5-12, reaches a minimum of roughly -6% at Layer13-20, and then steadily increases to end at approximately -1% at Layer29-32. Finally, a solid dark blue line with square markers, labeled "RULER4k of 1x tokens, 16-bit", begins at approximately -1% at Layer1-4, drops to about -5.5% at Layer5-12, reaches its lowest point at roughly -14.5% at Layer13-20, and then sharply increases through -11% at Layer21-28 to finish at approximately -1.5% at Layer29-32.
